sections.title: Trait mechanics
lines: Amphibious · Breathes air and water.
Standing Leap · Long jump up to 20 ft. or high jump up to 10 ft., including from a standstill.

sections.title: Action mechanics
lines: Bite · Grapple the target on a hit (escape DC 12). It remains restrained, and the frog cannot Bite another target until the grapple ends.

Swallow · Make a Bite attack against a grappled Small or smaller target. On a hit the target is swallowed and the grapple ends. The frog can hold one swallowed creature. The victim is blinded and restrained, has total cover from effects outside the frog, and takes 5 (2d4) acid damage at the start of the frog’s turns. If the victim damages the frog, at the end of that turn the frog must make a DC 10 CON save or regurgitate it prone within 5 ft. If the frog dies, the victim can exit prone using 5 ft. of movement and is no longer restrained.

sections.title: Bonus action mechanics
lines: Reeling Tongue · One visible Medium or smaller creature within 15 ft. makes a DC 12 STR save or is pulled up to 10 ft. closer.
